result.summary: The image depicts a wide urban intersection with commercial and industrial land use. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like sidewalks and signals are present, the environment is dominated by asphalt with faded markings and long crossing distances.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The continental crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the center of the roadway

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The lack of a median or refuge island on a wide roadway increases pedestrian exposure time to traffic.

hazards.name: Large Curb Radii
hazards.description: The rounded corners allow vehicles to make turns at higher speeds, increasing the risk of collisions with pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalks using high-visibility thermoplastic markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median island to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians mid-crossing.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a wide sidewalk that abruptly transitions into a large, undefined gas station apron. This creates a significant conflict zone where pedestrians must navigate a wide expanse of asphalt used by vehicles entering and exiting the commercial property without clear separation or markings.

hazards.name: Excessive Driveway Width
hazards.description: The gas station entrance creates a massive gap in the sidewalk, forcing pedestrians to cross a wide, unprotected area where vehicles can enter or exit at high speeds and various angles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and right foreground where the sidewalk meets the gas station lot

hazards.name: Lack of Sidewalk Continuity
hazards.description: The paved walkway ends and merges into the asphalt of the gas station, removing the physical and visual cues that define a safe pedestrian space.
hazards.location_in_image: Transition point between the concrete sidewalk and the asphalt lot

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation and Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the gas station entrance to the minimum necessary for safe vehicle access, thereby reducing the pedestrian exposure distance.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk Treatment
interventions.description: Extend the concrete sidewalk material and elevation across the driveway to clearly signal pedestrian priority and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Bollards or Planters
interventions.description: Install physical barriers to define the edge of the pedestrian path and prevent vehicles from encroaching on the sidewalk area outside of designated access points.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment at this signalized intersection includes sidewalks and pedestrian signals but lacks visible crosswalk markings. The roadway is wide due to the inclusion of trolley tracks, which increases the unprotected crossing distance for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked crosswalks
hazards.description: The absence of high-visibility crosswalk markings at a signalized intersection reduces driver awareness of pedestrian crossing points.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main intersection in the foreground

hazards.name: Wide crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross a wide expanse of roadway without a refuge island, increasing exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Uneven pavement
hazards.description: The pavement around the trolley tracks is cracked and uneven, creating a potential tripping hazard.

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian space and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Curb extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to reduce the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian refuge island
interventions.description: Construct a median refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide roadway in two stages.

result.summary: The image depicts a wide urban intersection featuring integrated trolley tracks and standard pedestrian infrastructure such as sidewalks and signals. While basic facilities are present, the significant crossing distances and faded pavement markings indicate a street environment that prioritizes vehicular and transit throughput over pedestrian comfort.

hazards.name: Trolley tracks
hazards.description: Embedded tracks in the roadway create a tripping hazard for pedestrians and a slipping hazard for all users, especially in wet conditions.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway extending through the intersection
